plan.subject: LLM agents

queries.rationale: Catches papers explicitly naming new agent architectures, scoped to LLM agents.

queries.query: (framework OR system OR design) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Catches papers describing new frameworks or systems for building LLM agents using broader terminology.

queries.query: ("chain of thought" OR CoT) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Focuses on the canonical CoT technique as applied to agents.

queries.query: (planning OR reasoning) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent") AND NOT (robot OR robotic)
queries.rationale: Catches broader planning and reasoning research for LLM agents, explicitly excluding physical robotics.

queries.query: "tool use" AND ("LLM" OR "language model") AND agent
queries.rationale: Catches papers explicitly about LLM agents using tools.

queries.query: ("function calling" OR "API calling") AND ("LLM" OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Catches papers focused on the specific function/API calling paradigm for LLMs.

queries.angle: memory systems and retrieval (RAG / long-term memory)
queries.query: (RAG OR "retrieval-augmented generation") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Focuses on RAG techniques specifically for agents.

queries.angle: memory systems and retrieval (RAG / long-term memory)
queries.query: ("long-term memory" OR "memory system") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Catches agent research on memory systems beyond just RAG.

queries.query: (orchestration OR collaboration OR swarm) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Catches papers on orchestration and collaborative dynamics between LLM agents.

queries.angle: evaluation, benchmarks, or agent capability tests
queries.query: (benchmark OR evaluation) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Catches papers on evaluating or benchmarking LLM agent performance.

queries.angle: evaluation, benchmarks, or agent capability tests
queries.query: ("agent capability" OR "agent test") AND ("LLM" OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Focuses on tests and capability assessments specific to agents.

queries.query: (deployment OR "production") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Catches engineering-focused papers on deploying agents to production.

queries.query: (observability OR monitoring OR cost) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Catches papers on monitoring, observability, and cost management for agents.

queries.angle: safety, alignment, or guardrails for agents
queries.query: (safety OR alignment) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Catches core safety and alignment research for LLM agents.

queries.angle: safety, alignment, or guardrails for agents
queries.query: (guardrail OR "content moderation" OR "harmful content") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Focuses on practical guardrails and content safety mechanisms for agents.

plan.coverage_notes: Plan uses slot 1 for canonical, precise phrasing of each angle and slot 2 for broader, complementary terminology. The 'planning' angle was tricky to scope without robotics noise; added a NOT clause to improve precision.
